recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a house with fifteen million underground tunnels quietly listed for sale
language models relearning Victorian telegraph shorthand
JPEG XL arriving in Chrome browsers
clear autumn night over San Francisco, fourteen degrees
wide temperature swing from cool night to warm afternoon
agents spun up from a phone before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Navigate a cross-section of an absurd underground tunnel listing — swipe between forked passages before dead ends collapse, grabbing price tags from rooms that shouldn't exist.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: lane switch at three-way tunnel splits
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to pick the live branch
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each fork is a three-second read — one clean run maps the whole absurd floor plan
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: splits come faster, decoy rooms flash higher prices, ceiling debris narrows the safe lane
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: warm lamp-lit tunnel blueprint cross-section, autumn rust on concrete

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap telegraph pulses into dot-dash rhythm as Victorian phrases compress down a wire — the model rewrites your taps into tighter telegraphese on each beat.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: rhythm tap on morse-style pulse lanes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one phrase per round — watch a bloated sentence shrink into a perfect wire-length burst
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tempo climbs, extra symbol lanes open, off-beat taps garble the output
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: sepia ticker tape and brass telegraph keys

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one-thumb paths from phone shortcut chips to matching cloud-agent hubs before a sunrise deadline — each link spins up a worker that clears a backlog tile.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to connect chip to hub
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clear the whole backlog in under a minute as agents light up in sequence
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more hub types appear, crossing paths short-circuit, sunrise bar accelerates
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: foggy dawn San Francisco glass widgets over a dark bay

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick JPEG XL quality blocks into compression bins while chroma artifacts bounce around the screen — wrong bin adds visual noise that obscures the next toss.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each round ships one image — hit the size/quality target before the browser bar fills
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: artifact orbs multiply, bins shrink, blocks gain spin and weight
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe codec lab with chrome-shipping progress meter
